directionsTap: Tap the first letter of a word, then its last letter. Found words are numbered in the grid and crossed off the list.
directionsDiagonal: Words run across, down or diagonally.
directionsKeyboard: With a keyboard: move with the arrow keys, press Enter or Space on the first letter and again on the last letter. Escape clears the first letter.
startAt: Start at {letter}, row {row} column {column}. Now choose the last letter.
empty: Add words to make a puzzle.
unplaced: These words do not fit in the grid and are left out:
editing: Play is paused while you edit.
